quarterly_data.signal: Zhen Ding MOPS filing: subsidiary Qing Ding Precision Electronics (Huai'an) acquired land use rights (50-year term) to two industrial plots in the Huai'an Economic and Technological Development Zone through a tender from the Huai'an Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources and Planning (not a related party): the plot east of Fujing Road, 63,253.3 square metres, for RMB 2,417 ten-thousand, and the plot east of Baowu Road, 147,106.8 square metres, for RMB 5,458 ten-thousand; approved by the Chairman on 10-01-2026; stated purpose: for operational development.
